name: Aam Digital
description: Easy-to-use case management software for the social sector that improves the effectiveness and transparency of work with beneficiaries. The offline-first web app is tailored to be used by NGOs anywhere in the world.

name: AgriOS
description: AgriOS is an open-source, subscription-free ERP designed for African agri-SMEs. It integrates business operations with traceability to improve efficiency, ensure compliance, and unlock access to finance.

name: Apache Fineract
description: Fineract provides a reliable, robust, and affordable solution for entrepreneurs, financial institutions, and service providers to offer financial services to the world’s 3 billion underbanked and unbanked.

name: Boxtribute
description: An open-source digital system making it easy to rapidly and collaboratively source, store & distribute humanitarian aid to people in need in a fair and dignified way.

name: Cider
description: Cider is a set of software tools for estimating the poverty status of individuals and households using mobile phone data, for use in the targeting and delivery of humanitarian aid.

name: CKAN
description: CKAN is an Open Source Data Management System to build Data Portals. Trusted by hundreds of portals across the world and supported by an active community, it focuses on extensibility and integration with other tools.

name: ekShop Marketplace
description: ekShop marketplace is a robust and adaptable eCommerce platform that is free and open-source. It is designed to cater to the needs of any potential entrepreneur who wants to set up an online store quickly and efficiently. With its customizable and configurable features, ekShop can be tailored to suit your specific requirements.

name: Harmony
description: Harmony is an open-source, end-to end data integration and advanced analytics platform for integrating, harmonizing, analyzing, and visualizing any number of structured data sources from different sectors (e.g. health, education, agriculture, sustainable development, climate change adaptation), ranging from routinely collected individual level data to operational research and survey data.

name: HOPE
description: HOPE is UNICEF’s humanitarian cash transfer management information system. HOPE allows to register and target beneficaries, track approval of payment list send them to payment providers, process reconciliation and payment verification and facilitate grievances and feedbacks.

name: Mifos Payment Hub-EE (PH-EE)
description: Modern orchestation engine for digital & real-time Payments enabling DFSPs to connect to and participate in instant inclusive payment systems and for governments to disburse payments in bulk to functional wallet accounts.

name: Mifos X
description: The Mifos X DPG suite includes a core banking platform, payment orchestration engine, and mobile banking interfaces to enable the effective delivery of digital financial services such as savings and credit-led financial inclusion, G2P payments, integration into IIPS and more.

name: Mojaloop
description: Open source software for creating payment platforms that will help unbanked people access digital financial services.

name: MOSIP
description: The Modular Open Source Identity Platform (MOSIP) helps Governments and other user organizations implement a digital, foundational identity system in a cost effective way.

name: ODK
description: ODK lets you build powerful forms to collect the data you need wherever it is. Join the leading researchers, field teams, and other professionals using ODK to collect data that matters.

name: OpenFisca
description: OpenFisca is a Rules as Code engine: it enables collaboratively making laws and regulations computable over APIs for developers, datascientists and researchers. This allows building software to help citizens and businesses understand how laws apply to them, designing better rules and public policies, debating potential reforms, and scaling economic micro-simulation.

name: OpenFn
description: OpenFn is a workflow automation platform that's used to automate & integrate critical business processes and systems. From last-mile services to national-level reporting, it boosts efficiency & effectiveness while enabling secure, stable, scalable interoperability at all levels.

name: OpenG2P
description: OpenG2P is an open-source platform that enables governments and humanitarian organizations to deliver critical social benefits directly to those who need them. It facilitates the building of secure, inclusive registries and digital cash transfer systems for social protection.

name: openIMIS
description: openIMIS is a versatile open source software which supports the administration of health financing and social protection schemes. It is specially designed to manage the complex, high-volume data flows which are required to operate such schemes by seamlessly integrating beneficiary, provider and payer data in a single platform.

name: OpenSPP
description: OpenSPP is an integrated and digital social protection information system that enables governments and humanitarian agencies to streamline the creation and management of assistance programs.

name: POTLOCK
description: POTLUCK is the portal for public goods, non-profits, and communities to raise funds transparently through a global donor network built on blockchain.

name: PRISM
description: PRISM is a climate risk monitoring system that integrates geospatial data on hazards such as droughts, floods, tropical storms, and earthquakes, along with information on socioeconomic vulnerability, to inform disaster risk reduction and social assistance programmes.

name: Rahat
description: Rahat is a collection of open-source, blockchain-powered projects for cash and aid distribution and management. It enables the efficient and transparent coordination of resources and relief efforts. By leveraging token-based transfers, Rahat supports anticipatory cash and voucher

name: TruBudget
description: A blockchain-based workflow tool for an efficient and transparent project management

name: X-Road®
description: X-Road® is open-source software that provides unified and secure data exchange between organisations in a collaborative ecosystem.
